title: clusterMap of tpg-backup-expire
description: The clusterMap input of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-backup-expire: registered clusters, their keys and their instances. Generated from workflows/params/cluster-map-keys.yaml by workflows/params/clustermap_schema.py; the validate step of the workflow is the authority (registered clusters, required values an input may supply, combinations of values).

instances.description: The instances of the cluster (namespace: the key namespace of tpg-day0 and tpg-create-instance, default pg-<instance>); at least one

purgeBackups.description: Round 23. tpg-delete-instance, tpg-delete-apps: as the input - expire every PostgresBackup of the instance while it runs, then delete every blob left under its container and repoPath after it is gone (irreversible; needs finalBackup false; a repoPath another PostgresBackupLocation on any registered cluster uses is expired only, blobs kept and reported). tpg-backup-expire: true expires every backup of the instance and never deletes blobs; not together with backups [Boolean; optional]

backups.description: Round 23, tpg-backup-expire: the PostgresBackup names to expire (a list in brackets, [orders-db-full-202609010100]). A full backup that has dependent differential or incremental backups needs includeDependents: true (else the instance is BLOCKED and the dependents are listed). Not together with purgeBackups [List (names); optional]

includeDependents.description: Round 23, tpg-backup-expire: true also expires the differential and incremental backups that depend on the listed ones (dependents first); required to expire a backup that has dependents. With backups only [Boolean; optional]
